description:
Saves the network settings; send only what changes. Fields set by environment variables are ignored. Every trusted_ips entry must be an IPv4 or IPv6 address or a CIDR range, otherwise the answer is 400. The change reloads nginx and is applied before it is saved: when applying fails, nothing is saved.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

requestBody.description: The settings to change; fields you leave out keep their value

trusted_ips.description: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges whose X-Forwarded-For / PROXY protocol address is trusted (env TRUST_IP)

trust_cloudflare.description: Trust the Cloudflare IP ranges (env TRUST_CLOUDFLARE)

200.description: The network settings after the save, in the same form as the GET answer
